newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea 3-yr yields end higher on drying liquidity.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea 3-yr yields end higher on drying liquidity.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed higher on Monday as liquidity dried up after the central bank's money absorption through repurchase agreements, brokers said.
The three-month CDs remained unchanged with few new issues, and the overnight call rate edged up due to rising money demand, they said.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.65 pct from 12.57 on Saturday
The three-month CDs remained flat with few new issues,
The overnight call rate edged up due to rising money demand in the short-term money market.
"Banks appear short of meeting the central bank's reserve requirements," Yoo said.
New issues for the three-year corporates were estimated at 14 billion won today against Tuesday's 31.6 billion won.
